about: Byte budgets for the production client build, enforced by scripts/check-page-budgets.mjs (make budget, and the production image job in CI). Text is measured gzipped at level 9, images as they are. Each number is about 10% above what the build measured when it was set (2026-09-17), except entry-css, which is 21 bytes and has a floor instead. To raise one deliberately, change it here in the pull request that needs it and say why in that pull request.
